defect_reproduction.method: Executed the failing test on both runtimes with an instrumented copy that logs the thrown value before the assertion runs, rather than reading the assertion and inferring. Same test body, same assertion, same built checkout; only the node binary differed.
defect_reproduction.node_20: v20.20.2 — PROBE: threw PrivilegedAccessDeniedError code= COMMAND_CENTER_AUTH_REQUIRED instanceof= false -> not ok 1, # pass 0 # fail 1
defect_reproduction.node_22: v22.22.1 — PROBE: threw PrivilegedAccessDeniedError code= COMMAND_CENTER_AUTH_REQUIRED instanceof= true -> ok 1, # pass 1 # fail 0
defect_reproduction.cause: Under Node 20's loader, ../request-auth resolves to two distinct module instances, so the test's imported PrivilegedAccessDeniedError is a different class object from the one server-api.ts throws. instanceof is therefore false against an error that is, by class name and by code, exactly the expected one.
defect_reproduction.not_a_fail_open: The guard refuses the unauthenticated request on BOTH runtimes, with the correct error and the correct code. No request was admitted without authorization on either. The assertion was correctly reporting an unsupported runtime.
